entries.title: Escrow whole-balance seed lets a third party donate sUSDS/phUSD before exitAndSeed and skew the opening pair price
entries.reason: Economically refuted (ECON clearedChecks Q6: donor recovers less than the gift under constant product; sUSDS donation is a gift to POL). Root cause in yield-claim-nft, accepted in escrow NatSpec. Parked rather than dropped because the skewed spot is read by UniPoolerV2.quotePool / UniswapHelper quotes before arbitrage -- re-check if any on-chain consumer acts on that spot in the seed block.

entries.title: Residual OWNER sUSDS/phUSD allowance to Router02 if step 6 lands against a non-empty pair or reverts
entries.reason: Router02 pulls only from msg.sender, so a standing allowance is not exploitable by third parties; below threshold. Linked to DEDUP-001 scenario A (seed revert leaves the approvals standing). Story-103 verify could assert allowances reset.

entries.title: Core reads BPT token from owner-mutable old.pool(); a past repoint would leave previous-pool BPT unwithdrawn and unchecked (core-side analogue of ycn L-27)
entries.reason: Owner footgun (Law 3); mainnet pool() never repointed. The planned story-103 guard require(old.pool()==escrow.bpt()) is tracked as an unlanded obligation in DEDUP-009. Parked for re-check when 103 lands.

entries.title: UniswapHelper does not reject minOut==0; when the PSM USDC leg floors to 0, swapPhUSDToETH returns ethOut=0 and the whole value comes back as USDS dust
entries.reason: User-input (C4 invalid for minOut==0); ethOut==0 split proven benign (Halmos P7 PASS < 2^128, tout=0; P8 zero-gem + minEthOut>0 always reverts). Dust-scale (<1e12 wei USDS). Parked as a UI-integration note: UI must never submit minOut==0.

entries.title: Non-view QuoterV2-based quotes (quoteETHToPhUSD/quotePhUSDToETH) and spot V2 quotes are same-tx manipulable if an integrator consumes them on-chain
entries.reason: No in-protocol consumer; NatSpec restricts to eth_call. Integrator footgun only; parked for visibility.
